decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, site location plan, 708/01, 02 and 03 all received 11/01/2011)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The ground floor use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [0700-2230 Monday to Friday, 0800-2230 on Saturday and 0900-1700 on Sundays and Bank Holidays].

Condition : 4 - 4.	The development shall not be occupied until a secure storage area within the site that is enclosed by a two metre high close-boarded fence has been made available. This should contain at least two 1100L Eurobin waste storage bins together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials, which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the bins in the designated area. The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied in to them. Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 6 - The access doorway to the ground floor unit shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of the ground floor from A1 (retail shop) to A3 (restaurant/caf?) and the continued use of the first floor as offices.
